summary:
SpaceHealth is an integrated astronaut health monitoring system developed to support crew health and safety during space missions. It includes health assessments, a clickable Human Body Explorer, Mission Simulator, cognitive health games, personalized preventive recommendations, health analytics and Flight Surgeon Mode.

It addresses spaceflight challenges such as microgravity, radiation exposure, stress, sleep disturbances and limited access to immediate medical assistance by monitoring health indicators, identifying potential health concerns and supporting preventive care.

Its importance lies in helping astronauts maintain physical and mental well-being, supporting early identification of health concerns and improving medical decision-making, especially during long-duration space missions.
details: SpaceHealth is an astronaut health monitoring and decision-support system designed to support the physical and mental well-being of astronauts during space missions. It analyses health data such as heart rate, blood pressure, oxygen levels, glucose, sleep and symptoms to identify potential health concerns and provide personalized preventive recommendations. The project includes a Human Body Explorer, Mission Simulator, cognitive games, health analytics, health history and Flight Surgeon Mode, helping users monitor health and assess mission readiness. It aims to encourage early identification of health risks, improve astronaut safety and support better decision-making during long-duration space missions. We developed it using HTML, CSS and JavaScript for the frontend, Python with Flask for the backend, SQLite for data storage and Chart.js for visualizations. The project is creative because it combines physical health monitoring, mental fitness, interactive body exploration and mission simulation in one platform. Key factors considered include microgravity, radiation exposure, stress, sleep patterns, cognitive performance, limited medical access and communication delays.
